description: Delorean-AIXM is an open-source tool that turns a PostgreSQL database into an aeronautical mapping database for AIXM (Aeronautical Information Exchange Model) data. It supports every feature type of AIXM 5.1, 5.1.1 and 5.2 and offers extract, transform and load functions to marshal and unmarshal zipped, plain or remote files, persist, merge, filter, prune, diff and validate against the XSD, with GML geometries and the baseline and permanent-delta temporal concepts; digital NOTAM handling and GIS, web and feature server integration are stated goals. The developer, publishing as 3l-gee on GitHub, built it because the aviation industry lacks a simple, accessible way to handle AIXM data. Coverage: any AIXM data set, national or European. Access: source code on GitHub. Licence and cost: GNU GPL version 3, free. Caveats: temporary deltas, snapshots, extensions and EAD business rules are not yet implemented, and it is a single-developer project. It prepares airports, runways, navaids and airspace structures from national aeronautical information for network, capacity and hazard exposure studies of aviation, and pairs with aeronautical data catalogued here such as the French SIA aeronautical information and the ICAO API data service.
